subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Which existing overlapping fix path should be canonical for the remaining session-fence and subagent-delivery behavior in this issue?
rationale: The issue spans retained locks, session-fence false positives, suspended subagent delivery, and typing cleanup; current main fixes only the retained-lock slice while several open PRs propose different permanent boundaries.

options.title: Sequence Existing PRs
options.body: Review and land or close the existing focused PRs before authorizing any new ClawSweeper fix branch.

options.title: Split A Narrow Canonical Follow-Up
options.body: Move only the still-unfixed slice into a narrower canonical issue and link this issue's evidence there.

options.title: Require Fresh Live Repro First
options.body: Wait for a current-main live Telegram or cron-density reproduction before choosing the code path.

recommendation.title: Sequence Existing PRs
recommendation.body: Review and land or close the existing focused PRs before authorizing any new ClawSweeper fix branch.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest broad history across subagent registry and delivery code, while the candidate PR authors each cover only one slice.
